options.label: RFC-0020 metric (Recommended)
options.description: Add a per-round marginal-return metric (non-loop-introduced must-fix per M units, from ship-report origin tags) to RFC-0020 § Metrics for both runs A and B, with the paper cited. Measurement only: no new stop rule before run B, so the decision rule stays fixed. Lands under BK-418 with its trace.

options.label: Research note
options.description: New short sdd/research/ note mapping the paper onto /ship (the table above plus caveats), linked from RFC-0020. Durable reference, no change to the experiment.

options.label: Also an SL-style stop
options.description: Both the metric and a new RFC-0020 intervention P5: stop the loop after k consecutive rounds whose marginal return is below ε. Bigger change: it amends the run B design and the ADR-0033/0034 targets.

options.label: Discussion only
options.description: Nothing durable for now; keep this as chat analysis.
